doc: The blend in float64 (f = 0.6): the float32 variants above read this as the closed form. rtol 1e-9. Arguments: p and back (inputs, direction vectors of shape (..., 3)) and f (params): q = normalize(p (1 - f) + back f), with normalize(v) = v / ||v|| over the last axis (sphere.py) and NO epsilon guard: a zero vector gives 0 / 0 = NaN, not 0. The blend and the norm run in the dtype of the inputs (float32 vectors: float32 norm). Measured: one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 3.3e-16 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is about 7e4x that spread.
